name: Seth Ulvestad
residence: Cheyenne, Laramie County (he wrote that he had lived there since March 2023; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
occupation: Senior policy and planning analyst, State of Wyoming Enterprise Technology Services (2024 WyoFile questionnaire); formerly executive director of the Sheridan Recreation District
education: Sheridan High School; bachelor's degree, Black Hills State University (field not stated); Master of Public Administration (institution not named in the 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Seth Ulvestad wrote that he lived in Cheyenne and had been there since March 2023, was born in Springfield, Ohio, and that his family moved to Wyoming in 1994 when he was 2. He said he would be 32 on Election Day 2024. He wrote that he grew up in Buffalo and Sheridan, graduated from Sheridan High School, and had an internship with the Wyoming State Legislature.

He wrote that he attended Black Hills State University in Spearfish, South Dakota, competed in cross country and track, participated in student government, was president of the CRUX rock climbing club, and graduated with a bachelor’s degree (field not stated). After college he worked for the Sheridan Recreation District, starting as a recreation supervisor and finishing as executive director, and earned a Master of Public Administration (institution not named). A state job brought him to Cheyenne, where he wrote that he was a senior policy and planning analyst with Enterprise Technology Services, a citizen representative on the City of Cheyenne Greenway Commission, and treasurer for the Wyoming State Museum Volunteers.
